The [[Mountains of Lightning]] were a chain of rocky, crystalline peaks located outside of the city of [[Hweg Shul]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. These mountains were said to be the source of fierce [[Force storm (weather)|Force Storms]] that swept through the surrounding valleys. Senator [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] owned a small residence in the mountains for some time.
